timing_verdict.label: GOOD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: GOOD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,400 KRW/USD (expected near-term)

WHY: The news consistently reports that SK Hynix's $25.6–26.5 billion capital inflow from US listing is creating strong downward pressure on the KRW/USD rate (weakening the won, making dollars cheaper). Multiple sources describe this as a "currency swap-level" dollar supply event that should push the rate toward the 1,400 level, suggesting the won is currently stronger than usual.

TIP: Lock in this month's $2,000 conversion now while the won strength is boosted by the Hynix inflow; the stabilizing effect may be temporary if oil prices or other variables shift direction.
